DESCRIPTION:
Run a single orchestration to completion. Uses a running instance when one is 
configured and healthy (auto), else spawns an isolated one-shot host

USAGE:
    orchestra run [NAME] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    orchestra run research-assistant --param topic=AI
    orchestra run --run-file ./pipeline.yaml --report markdown
    orchestra run deploy-pipeline --mode existing -q

ARGUMENTS:
    [NAME]    Orchestration name (or ID) to run. Omit when using --run-file

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                         Prints help information                  
    -s, --server <URL>                 Orchestra server URL (default:           
                                       $ORCHESTRA_URL or http://localhost:5000) 
        --no-interactive               Don't prompt on HITL pauses; print the   
                                       pending-input message and exit 2         
    -q, --quiet                        Suppress per-step chatter; show only HITL
                                       prompts and final summary                
    -V, --verbose                      Print every SSE event (firehose). Wins   
                                       over --quiet if both are passed          
        --by <NAME>                    Audit identifier recorded with any HITL  
                                       responses you submit                     
        --run-file <PATH>              Register the given orchestration file,   
                                       then run it (instead of <NAME>)          
        --mode <MODE>                  Host selection: auto (default) | isolated
                                       | existing                               
        --param <KEY=VALUE>            Repeated runtime parameter. Example:     
                                       --param topic=AI --param length=short    
        --run-timeout <SECONDS>        Hard wall-clock timeout for the run, in  
                                       seconds                                  
        --output <FILE>
